subject: Human Body
title: Hormone Replacement Therapy
description: A fast breakdown of Hormone Replacement Therapy for builders.

hook.text: Menopause drops estrogen levels sharply. Hot flashes, bone loss, and mood swings follow. HRT can replace what's lost.

buildup.text: HRT provides synthetic estrogen and sometimes progesterone. It reduces symptoms and protects bones from osteoporosis.

discovery.text: Testosterone replacement helps men with clinically low levels.

twist.text: A 2002 study found HRT slightly increased breast cancer risk. Millions of women stopped overnight.

punchline.text: Replacing lost hormones works. But the risk-benefit math is personal.

quiz.question: Why did many women stop HRT after 2002?
options: It was found to be completely ineffective
A study found it slightly increased breast cancer risk
Synthetic hormones were banned by regulators
